learned: 2026-10-08, by hand: 1906dispensary.com (Shopify, the brand's dispensary-edition site) lists 15 products, one per formula, with no variants and no prices (all 0.00, available=false). Each description states the THC per piece and which states sell it; each product page's Supplement Facts states the tin count ('Tin Servings: 20') and, for the pouch, only '1 to 2 by state market'. 13 are sold in New York (2 are MA-only), read here as 23 product-size pairs.
notes: products.json is read twice, once per package (the '#tin' and '#pouch' fragments never reach the server; the rules read them from `page`). Every product is one Shopify product with a 'Default Title' variant, so the package is not on the site as a variant: the tin count comes from the product page's Supplement Facts, the NY pouch count from NY store names. Product pages answered a 'Your connection needs to be verified' challenge after about a dozen requests in a row, so the recipe reads products.json only, and sizes are rule constants checked against the dose the description states. A new product falls through to 'no title rule'.

Tins (from Supplement Facts, Serving Size x Tin Servings): the 5mg Drops (Bliss, Boost, Chill, Go, Sleep) and Go Beans are 1 drop x 20 = 20pk 100mg; Genius and Love are 2.5mg drops, 2 drops x 15 servings = 30pk 75mg. Stores agree (8, 5, 7, 6, 6 stores; Genius 5, Love 6). Love Beans' page answered the verification challenge when read, so its tin count is taken as Go Beans' (20 x 5mg); check it on the page. The beans are sold in CO and NY and seen at one NY store each (Go Beans 20pk 100mg; Go and Love Beans 10mg).

Pouches: the site says '1 to 2 by state market'. New York's is 2 servings: 2pk 10mg for the 5mg drops and beans, 4pk 10mg for Genius and Love ('1906 | 10mg Pouch 2pk Drops', '1906 - Genius Drops 4pk - 10mg'). Many stores put 20mg or 40mg in the size field for these (THC and CBD added); THC only is 10mg, and store_skip drops those.

Boost+ 30mg: the description says 30mg THC per drop; its Supplement Facts panel (10mg, Tin Servings 10, Pouch Servings 9) is stale. New York sells it only as a 3-drop pouch, 3pk 90mg (NY's 100mg package cap rules out a tin). Written as strain Boost, as every NY store names it ('1906 - Boost Drops 3pk - 90mg', '1906 Boost Pouch 3pk'): 'Boost+' reads as 'Boost and' in the name keys and would miss them, and its product key is Boost's anyway.

Relief AM 25mg and Relief PM 25mg are the NY gummies (the 20mg pair says 'Available in MA Dispensaries'). The site gives 25mg THC a piece and no count; NY stores sell a 4pk 100mg pouch ('Relief AM ... Gummies 4pk - 100mg'). Line Relief, strain AM / PM (the effect rule: Relief is the family).
Lines: Drops (data/product_lines.json '1906'), Beans (the chocolate 'Go Beans', 'Love Beans'), Relief. The effect is the strain.
Skips by body text: 'Available in MA' (Relief 20mg pair, RSO 5mg). A product whose description moves to MA-only drops out by itself.

store_skip drops the stores' consensus sizes that add CBD (and CBG) to the THC: the pouches as 2pk 20mg and 4pk 40mg, and a Boost '20pk 20mg' that is no package. 'Drops Sleep' 2pk 20mg filed under tinctures is the same pouch.
